This page contains a schedule of the topics, content, and assignments for the semester.
Note that this schedule will be updated as necessary as the semester progresses, with all changes documented here.

Instructions to save the slides as PDFs can be found [here](https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/presenting.html#print-to-pdf). The key is to hit `E` when the slides are open in your browser (ideally Chrome, but it may work in others) to toggle into PDF print mode.

Readings can be accessed using the link (when needed, through the Cornell library with a Cornell login) or on Canvas.

::: {.callout-tip}
## How To Read This Schedule

- **Practice sets** go out on the day listed and are due at 9:00pm on the Friday listed. The solution key posts one day after the due date, when the late window closes.
- **Quizzes** take the first 25 minutes of the session listed. A quiz never covers material from the same week --- everything through the *previous* Friday is fair game, and nothing after it.
- **Readings** are due, with annotations and reflection, by the start of the first lecture the following week.
:::

{{< include _schedule-table.qmd >}}

## Quizzes and What They Cover

| Quiz | Date | Covers Through | Topics |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **Quiz 1** | Mon 2/08 | Fri 2/05 | Probability review, Monte Carlo |
| **Quiz 2** | Mon 2/22 | Fri 2/19 | Regression, the hinge, null models, both bootstraps |
| **Quiz 3** | Fri 3/05 | Fri 2/26 | The bootstrap in practice, Bayes, MCMC |
| **Quiz 4** | Fri 3/19 | Fri 3/12 | GLMs, maximum entropy, time series |
| **Quiz 5** | Fri 4/09 | Fri 3/26 | Extreme values |
| **Quiz 6** | Fri 4/30 | Fri 4/23 | Model evaluation and the criteria contrast |

The lowest quiz is dropped, for both 4850 and 5850.

::: {.callout-note}
## Why Quizzes 1 and 2 Are On Mondays

Every other quiz is on a Friday. The first two cannot be, because the Fridays they would need --- 2/12, 2/19, and 2/26 --- hold the three sessions this course is built around, and none of them can afford to lose 25 minutes. Quiz 1 needs to be early enough that you learn what a quiz looks like while it is still cheap, which rules out waiting.
:::
